evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies WalletDescriptor storage, wallet serialization, and RPCs including listdescriptors and exportwatchonly.
rationale: Preserving multipath descriptor relationships enables users coordinating with hardware signers that require policy registration to retrieve and re-verify registered descriptors via RPC. As noted in the PR description, this is necessary 'for working with hardware wallets that require policy registration, particularly those that require resending the descriptor that was registered.'
